phases/14-agent-engineering/43-frame-the.source: A coding agent can implement a clear task quickly. It can also implement an unclear task quickly. The speed is the same. The cost is not.
phases/14-agent-engineering/43-frame-the.translation: 编程智能体可以快速实现一项清晰的任务，也可以快速实现一项含糊的任务。速度相同，代价却不同。

phases/14-agent-engineering/44-plan-from.source: A plan is not a prettier to-do list. It is a dependency graph in which every change has a reason and every terminal node has proof.
phases/14-agent-engineering/44-plan-from.translation: 计划不是一份更漂亮的待办事项列表，而是一张依赖图：每项变更都有理由，每个终端节点都有验证依据。

phases/14-agent-engineering/45-delegate-.source: Parallel agents save wall time only when the work is independent. Otherwise they convert one clear task into a coordination problem with a faster failure rate.
phases/14-agent-engineering/45-delegate-.translation: 只有当工作彼此独立时，并行智能体才能缩短实际耗时。否则，它们只会把一个清晰的任务变成协调问题，并让失败来得更快。

phases/14-agent-engineering/46-turn-feed.source: A correction that lives only in chat fixes one run. A correction promoted into a test, boundary, example, or tool improves every later run.
phases/14-agent-engineering/46-turn-feed.translation: 只停留在聊天中的纠正只能修复一次运行；被固化为测试、边界、示例或工具的纠正，则会改善之后的每一次运行。

phases/14-agent-engineering/47-outcomes-.source: Fast implementation increases the penalty for choosing the wrong problem. Shape the outcome first so speed points in the right direction.
phases/14-agent-engineering/47-outcomes-.translation: 实现速度越快，选错问题的代价就越大。先明确成果，让速度指向正确方向。

phases/14-agent-engineering/48-discover-.source: Requirements are not waiting in a meeting to be collected. They are scattered across actions, workarounds, records, and disagreements.
phases/14-agent-engineering/48-discover-.translation: 需求并非等着你在会议中收集，而是散落在行动、变通做法、记录和分歧之中。

phases/14-agent-engineering/49-map-assum.source: A roadmap hides uncertainty inside features. An assumption map exposes what must be true before those features deserve to exist.
phases/14-agent-engineering/49-map-assum.translation: 路线图把不确定性藏在功能之中。假设图则揭示了这些功能要值得存在，必须先满足哪些条件。

phases/14-agent-engineering/50-choose-th.source: Small is useful only when it proves something important. A tiny build that cannot change the next decision is merely incomplete.
phases/14-agent-engineering/50-choose-th.translation: 只有在能够证明重要事项时，小才有意义。无法改变下一项决策的微型构建，不过是尚未完成而已。

phases/14-agent-engineering/51-write-spe.source: A useful specification fixes invariants and evidence while leaving reversible implementation choices open. It is a decision boundary, not a screenplay.
phases/14-agent-engineering/51-write-spe.translation: 一份有用的规格说明会固定不变量和证据，同时为可逆的实现选择留出空间。它是一条决策边界，而不是剧本。

phases/14-agent-engineering/52-design-su.source: Measurement should answer a decision, not decorate a dashboard. Start with the goal, derive questions, then choose the smallest metrics that answer them.
phases/14-agent-engineering/52-design-su.translation: 度量应当为决策提供答案，而不是装饰仪表盘。先从目标出发，由此推导问题，再选择能够回答这些问题的最少指标。

phases/14-agent-engineering/53-prototype.source: These are different learning environments, not levels of polish. Choose the stage that answers the current unknown with the least unnecessary consequence.
phases/14-agent-engineering/53-prototype.translation: 它们是不同的学习环境，而不是不同的打磨程度。应选择能够以最少不必要后果回答当前未知问题的阶段。

phases/14-agent-engineering/54-build-the.source: Shipping closes one build loop and opens the learning loop. Evidence must change the system or it becomes telemetry nobody owns.
phases/14-agent-engineering/54-build-the.translation: 交付结束了一轮构建循环，也开启了学习循环。证据必须推动系统发生改变，否则它只会成为无人负责的遥测数据。
